reasoning: The agent reliably clears the anchor-5 bar (constantly updating wrong signatures/fields/semantics revealed by the compiler and adjusting nearby code) and reaches anchor-8 on multiple occasions — recognizing whole designs are wrong (SPDY, CNI, admission webhook, ResourceMetricSource split, dual ResourceRequirements) and backing out to rework them, plus resequencing to targeted per-test builds when full builds became blocking. It falls short of a clean 8 and well short of 10 because of pervasive oscillation and self-inflicted regressions (claims added/removed repeatedly, phase/observed_generation re-removed by broad replaces, PolicyRule and NodeCondition flip-flops), showing it frequently failed to convert contradictory evidence into a durable model. This lands squarely between the 5 and 8 anchors, at 6.
